description: Add champion splash art backgrounds on match cards
steps: Update next.config.ts: Add 'cdn.communitydragon.org' to the remotePatterns for next/image since champion splash arts are available from Community Dragon CDN (ddragon does not serve splash arts in a convenient format for backgrounds).

Update app/components/MatchCard.tsx: Add a subtle champion splash art as the card background. Use the champion name to construct the splash art URL from ddragon (https://ddragon.leagueoflegends.com/cdn/img/champion/splash/{ChampionName}_0.jpg). Apply it as a CSS background-image with very low opacity (5-10%) so it does not interfere with text readability. Use a gradient overlay to ensure text contrast. The splash art should only show on hover or always be subtly visible.
Ensure the background works in both light and dark mode with appropriate opacity adjustments.
Verify the build passes with 'bunx next build' and lint passes with 'bunx eslint .'
acceptance_criteria: Match cards display the played champion's splash art as a subtle background
Text remains fully readable with proper contrast in both light and dark modes
Background does not cause layout shifts or performance issues (use CSS background-image, not next/image for the splash)
verification: Run 'bunx eslint .' and confirm zero errors
Run 'bunx next build' and confirm successful build with no TypeScript or compilation errors
findings: Implemented using CSS background-image approach with an inner wrapper pattern: outer article keeps overflow-visible for the Most Recent badge, inner div has overflow-hidden rounded-lg to clip the splash art. The NotImplementedError warnings from bun during build are pre-existing and do not affect the build outcome.
